description: This file contains unit tests for currency utility functions related to credit calculations and formatting, including conversions and UI rendering verification.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts USD amount to credits based on the configured exchange rate (CREDITS_PER_USD).

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats credit amount as a string with 'credits' suffix.

methods.name: renderCreditsWithUsd
methods.description: Renders a combined representation of credits and USD value, primarily displaying credits.
